tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Elementary Properties of Smooth Covering Maps] 1. chA:A.49[LeeSM, Prop. 4.33]

  1. Every smooth covering map is a local diffeomorphism, a smooth submersion, an open map, and a quotient map.

  2. An injective smooth covering map is a diffeomorphism.

  3. A topological covering map is a smooth covering map if and only if it is a local diffeomorphism.
